briefdescription.para: Windows ConPTY PTY implementation: duplex overlapped pipe, process creation, I/O, resize.

detaileddescription.para: This file implements the WindowsTTY interface using the Windows Pseudo Console (ConPTY) API with a single duplex overlapped named pipe, following the I/O model used by Microsoft Terminal's ConptyConnection.

sect3.title: Pipe topology
sect3.para: A single named pipe is created with PIPE_ACCESS_DUPLEX | FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED. The client end is opened with CreateFileW and passed for both hInput and hOutput to CreatePseudoConsole. After CreateProcessW the client handle is closed — ConPTY owns it internally. The parent retains only the server handle (pipe) for all I/O.

listitem.para: waitForData() issues ReadFile with readOverlapped, waits on readEvent, and stores the result in readBuffer / readBufferBytes.
read() copies from readBuffer to the caller's buffer.
write() issues WriteFile with writeOverlapped, waits on writeEvent.

entry.para: Child process handle for exit checks

listitem.para: signalThreadShouldExit() — tell reader thread to stop.
TerminateProcess() child immediately — fastest path to unblock the reader's overlapped ReadFile. No SIGTERM grace; instant kill per ARCHITECT.
ClosePseudoConsole() — breaks the pipe; reader observes ERROR_BROKEN_PIPE.
stopThread (instantKillJoinTimeoutMs) — bounded join on the reader.
